properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used for JWT token generation and validation.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.model
properties.description: Ollama embedding model to use for generating vector embeddings (e.g., all-minilm, nomic-embed-text).

properties.name: app.similarity.rag-threshold
properties.description: Minimum similarity threshold for RAG context retrieval (0.0 to 1.0). Higher values = more precise, fewer documents.

properties.name: app.similarity.conversation-threshold
properties.description: Minimum similarity threshold for conversation search (0.0 to 1.0). Can be less restrictive than RAG.

properties.name: app.similarity.default-threshold
properties.description: Default minimum similarity threshold for general document searches (0.0 to 1.0).

properties.name: app.rag.max-context-tokens
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens to include in RAG context to avoid exceeding model limits.

properties.name: app.rag.time-decay-days
properties.description: Number of days for time decay scoring. Documents older than this have exponentially lower relevance.

properties.name: app.rag.diversity-penalty
properties.description: Penalty factor (0.0 to 1.0) to reduce redundancy in retrieved documents. Higher = more diversity.

properties.name: app.rag.max-documents
properties.description: Maximum number of documents to retrieve and include in RAG context.

properties.name: app.rag.enable-reranking
properties.description: Enable advanced re-ranking algorithm using composite scores (similarity + recency + relevance).

properties.name: app.rag.enable-hybrid-search
properties.description: Enable hybrid search combining vector similarity with keyword matching (experimental).
